function.name: MAP_BUFFER
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
function.abstract: It returns a pointer to graph buffer

description.p: This advanced function returns a POINTER to graph buffer which is specified, that is, a pointer to the zone of memory where are save the real pixels which make the image. The graphs loaded with functions like LOAD_xxx or the created with are in the library 0.

The returned pointer is a pointer to BYTE for graphs of 8 bits and a pointer to WORD for graphs of 16 bits. Any manipulation of the content of this zone of memory affects directly to the content of the image.
Some practises with that function and with or , allow to make visual effects like erased or refilled with colours.
